cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Join the Guidni partner network today.

items.name: Karim B.
items.quote: Since joining Guidni, my bookings have tripled. The platform is easy to use and the support team is always there when I need them.

items.name: Sophie M.
items.quote: Guidni gave my small tour company the visibility I could never get on my own. The dashboard makes managing everything a breeze.

items.name: Fatima R.
items.quote: I was hesitant at first, but the onboarding was so smooth. Within a week I had my first booking from a traveller from France.

items.question: Is there a fee to join?
items.answer: There is no upfront cost to join Guidni. We charge a small commission only on confirmed bookings, so you only pay when you earn.

items.question: What types of businesses can join?
items.answer: We welcome activity providers, tour operators, accommodation hosts, and any business that offers travel experiences. If you offer something memorable to travellers, we want you on board.

items.question: How do I receive payments?
items.answer: Payments from bookings are transferred to your bank account on a regular payout schedule. You can view all earnings and payout history from your partner dashboard.

items.question: Can I manage my own availability?
items.answer: Absolutely. From your dashboard you have full control over your availability calendar, pricing, and booking windows at any time.

items.question: How long does it take to get approved?
items.answer: Your partner profile is activated immediately after you submit your application. You can start listing your services right away.

meta.title: About Guidni — One Platform for Your Entire Trip
meta.description: Learn about Guidni, the destination travel platform that brings activities, stays, restaurants, transport and guided tours together in one place.

hero.title: About
hero.subtitle: We are building the single platform where travelers can discover, plan, and book everything for their next trip — without switching between five different apps.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Guidni was born in Djerba. We kept watching travelers arrive in Tunisia with nothing but a hotel booking and a vague idea of things to do. They would miss the best restaurants. They would book the wrong activity. They would leave without experiencing what makes Djerba special.
story.p2: So we built the platform we wished existed. One place to discover, compare, and book activities, stays, restaurants, transport, and guided tours — all curated and verified, all in one seamless experience.
story.p3: We launched in 2025 and we are expanding to new destinations. The mission has not changed: every destination, one platform, zero compromise.

trust.title: Trust First
trust.body: Every partner on Guidni is reviewed before they can list. Every booking comes with instant confirmation. We do not let standards slip.

local.title: Local Expertise
local.body: We work directly with local operators, not resellers. When you book on Guidni, the money goes to the people who built something worth experiencing.

quality.title: Quality Standard
quality.body: We maintain a Guidni Quality Standard. Listings that fall below it are removed. Travelers who have a bad experience always hear from us.

cta.title: Ready to Explore?
cta.body: Discover experiences, book in seconds, and travel with confidence — only on Guidni.

meta.title: FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions · Guidni
meta.description: Find answers to common questions about booking on Guidni, payments, cancellations, and how to become a partner.

FAQPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about traveling and booking on Guidni.

travelers.a: Choose your experience, pick a date and time, fill in your details, and confirm. You will get an instant confirmation with a QR code that you show at the venue on arrival — no paper tickets needed.
Cancellation policies vary by listing. Each activity and stay shows its exact policy on the booking page. Most activities offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time.
We currently support cash payment on arrival. Online payment by card and via Konnect will be available soon. All prices are shown in TND (Tunisian Dinar).

travelers.q: Do I need an account to book?
travelers.a: Yes — a free account lets you track your bookings, access your QR codes, save your wishlist, and leave reviews after your experience.

travelers.q: What is the QR code for?
travelers.a: Each booking generates a unique QR code. You show it to the partner on arrival — they scan it to confirm your reservation instantly. No paper, no hassle.

partners.q: How do I list my activity or service?
partners.a: Apply via the Become a Partner page. We review all applications within 3 business days and reach out to confirm your listing details.
Guidni charges a percentage per completed booking. The exact rate depends on your category. Contact us for a full breakdown before you apply.
After your application is approved, our team reviews your profile. Accounts with complete information, professional photos, and positive reviews receive a Verified badge.

partners.q: How and when do I get paid?
partners.a: Earnings are tracked in your partner dashboard. You request a payout and we process it via bank transfer. Payout schedules will be confirmed at onboarding.

platform.a: Guidni is a destination travel platform. You can discover and book activities, stays, restaurants, transport, shops, and guided itineraries — all in one place, all verified.
Currently Djerba, Tunisia. We are expanding to Hammamet, Tunis, Dubai, and more destinations in 2025-2026.
Yes. Every listing is reviewed before it goes live. Bookings are confirmed instantly and backed by our customer support team. We stand behind every experience on the platform.

platform.q: Is Guidni available in multiple languages?
platform.a: Yes — Guidni is available in English, French, and Arabic with full RTL support. More languages are coming.

cta.title: Still have a question?
cta.body: Our team responds within 24 hours — usually much sooner.

meta.title: Terms of Service · Guidni
meta.description: Read Guidni terms of service — your rights and obligations when using the platform.

TermsPage.title: Terms of Service
TermsPage.subtitle: By using Guidni, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using Guidni (guidni.com), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform. These terms apply to all users including visitors, registered users, and partners.

sections.title: 2. Use of the Platform
sections.body: You may use Guidni only for lawful purposes. You agree not to engage in fraudulent activity, submit false reviews or bookings, impersonate any person, or violate any applicable law. Guidni reserves the right to suspend or terminate any account that violates these terms.

sections.title: 3. Bookings and Reservations
sections.body: When you make a booking on Guidni, you enter into a direct agreement with the partner providing the service. Guidni acts as an intermediary platform. Booking confirmations include a unique QR code. The cancellation policy shown on each listing governs refund eligibility.

sections.title: 4. Payments
sections.body: Prices are displayed in Tunisian Dinar (TND) unless otherwise indicated. Payment is currently collected at the venue upon arrival. Online payment will be introduced in a future update. Guidni charges partners a commission on completed bookings.

sections.title: 5. Partner Obligations
sections.body: Partners agree to provide accurate information, honor confirmed bookings, and maintain quality standards. Guidni reserves the right to remove listings that do not meet our standards or that receive sustained poor reviews.

sections.title: 6. Reviews and Content
sections.body: Reviews must be based on genuine experiences. False or abusive reviews may be removed. By submitting content to Guidni, you grant us a non-exclusive license to use and display that content in connection with the platform.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Guidni is a booking and discovery platform. We are not responsible for the quality or safety of services provided by partners. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our liability for any claim is limited to the amount paid for the relevant booking.

sections.title: 8. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or a platform notice. Continued use of Guidni after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

questions.title: Have questions about these terms?
questions.body: Our team is happy to clarify anything.

meta.title: Privacy Policy · Guidni
meta.description: How Guidni collects, uses, and protects your personal data.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.subtitle: We take your privacy seriously. Here is exactly what data we collect and how we use it.

sections.title: 1. What Data We Collect
sections.body: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and profile information. When you make a booking, we collect booking details including dates, participant count, and contact information. We may also collect usage data to improve the platform.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
sections.body: We use your data to process bookings and send confirmation emails, provide customer support, personalise your experience, and send marketing communications if you have opted in. We do not sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Third-Party Services
sections.body: We use Google OAuth for authentication, Cloudinary for image storage, and Konnect for payment processing (coming soon). Each provider has their own privacy policy. We only share the minimum data necessary for these services to function.

sections.title: 4. Data Storage and Security
sections.body: Your data is stored on secure servers. We use industry-standard encryption for data in transit (HTTPS) and at rest. We retain booking data for a minimum of 5 years for legal and tax compliance. You may request deletion of your account at any time.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion of your account, and opt out of marketing emails at any time. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at contact@guidni.com.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and analyse platform usage. See our Cookie Policy for a full list of cookies and how to opt out.

contact.title: Questions about your data?
contact.body: Email us at contact@guidni.com and we will respond within 48 hours.

meta.title: Cookie Policy · Guidni
meta.description: How Guidni uses cookies and how you can control them.

CookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
CookiesPage.subtitle: This page explains what cookies we use on Guidni, why we use them, and how you can control them.

sections.title: What Are Cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your preferences, keep you logged in, and collect analytics data. Cookies cannot access other files on your device or run programs.

sections.title: Essential Cookies
sections.body: These cookies are required for the platform to function. They include session cookies (to keep you logged in), security tokens (to prevent CSRF attacks), and language and destination preference cookies. These cannot be disabled without breaking core functionality.

sections.title: Analytics Cookies
sections.body: We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors use Guidni — which pages are most visited, where users drop off, and how long they spend on each section. This data is aggregated and anonymous. You can opt out via your browser settings.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Some third-party services we integrate with (such as Google OAuth for login) may set their own cookies. These are governed by their own privacy policies. Guidni does not control third-party cookies.

sections.title: How to Control Cookies
sections.body: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect your ability to stay logged in or use certain features. Most modern browsers allow you to block third-party cookies without affecting first-party session cookies.
